questions.title: Does the manual state these troubleshooting facts?

source.text: Some components like power capacitors and fans become worn out due to long term usage, and increase the risk of failure on the Active
Contact Danfoss for further information regarding maintenance and service.

proposal: 1. FailureMode 'Power capacitors worn out due to long-term usage' -> RESOLVED_BY -> CorrectiveAction 'Contact Danfoss for maintenance and service information' [escalation]. Meaning: For this problem or cause the manual says to contact service or the dealer.

2. FailureMode 'Fans worn out due to long-term usage' -> RESOLVED_BY -> CorrectiveAction 'Contact Danfoss for maintenance and service information' [escalation]. Meaning: For this problem or cause the manual says to contact service or the dealer.

options.label: Yes, all correct
options.effect: all statements enter the graph as verified

options.label: No, none is stated
options.effect: the statements stay out of the graph

options.label: Only some are correct
options.effect: only the statement numbers you list enter the graph

questions.title: Page 65 has no readable text next to diagnostic pages: should it be transcribed?
proposal: Page 65 is probably a figure or a scan; the system could not read it.

options.label: Skip it
options.effect: the page stays out of the graph

options.label: Transcribe it
options.effect: your transcription is kept in the run report for the next extraction

answers.rationale: The manual says power capacitors and fans can wear out with long-term use and advises contacting Danfoss for further maintenance and service information, supporting both escalation statements.
